summary: Enhance your organization's knowledge retention with our Institutional Memory Training Course. Equip your team to preserve vital information effectively.
lede: Knowledge retention training covers how to identify expertise at risk and preserve it through structured capture and transfer practices. It is for HR, learning and development, knowledge management, operations and project professionals who need to safeguard organizational knowledge. Participants learn to map knowledge risks, capture tacit and explicit knowledge, and develop documentation, handover, onboarding and succession practices.
audienceIntro: Ideal for professionals responsible for continuity, efficiency, and knowledge capital, including:
audience: NGO program continuity & grant compliance teams
modules: Knowledge Retention in Hybrid & Remote Work
